how hard is it to make a website like this? I would love to make one, got any tips?

Learning is a lot harder than doing. It took me a day to get this website online, but I've been programming for over a decade now. It won't take you that long to get the hang of things, more like a few months, but it's still not trivial.

The best tips depend on what you already know. I'll just assume you haven't learned how to program yet.

Online tutorials are a great way to get started, and Codecademy is probably the most popular website for them. I'd start with the html & css tutorial, then javascript. Those are the three languages that run client-side.

For a server-side language, you have more options. Ruby and Javascript are both great languages for a server. Php has a horrible design, but it's very easy to get started with and just get something working. C# is what I'm most accustomed to, but you really need to know C# well to use it on a server.

After you've finished one or two languages, you'll probably find Codecademy is a bit slow and holds your hand too much. You don't need to learn how to add in 4 different languages. Once you hit that point, you should just google for other tutorials, or send me a message if you can't find any. I'll help you out with that or any other questions if I can.

And remember, google is your best friend. Use it constantly. It will help you far more than I can.

Anyone can follow a tutorial and throw up a PHP/JS site on a cheap web host that accepts file uploads. I recommend it as a personal project if you already know something about making websites; you can use it for your own files or to share with friends and family.

The big problem is scalability, which no one has the complete answer to. Imgur struggles with it, reddit struggles with it, Twitter, Facebook, Google, Apple… But if you ever get to that point, you should probably be hiring very smart people to deal with it :P
